metadata.title: The Dream Station — A small story for the quieter hours
metadata.description: A short, choice-driven interactive story. Visit KURU at the Dream Station and leave a little worry for the morning.

experience.ageTitle: A small story for the quieter hours.
experience.ageCopy: This early interactive story is intended for adults aged 18 and over. It is a gentle creative experience, not therapy, counselling or mental-health support.
experience.ageNote: Age is self-declared in this prototype. No identity information is collected.
experience.inviteTitle: A friend left the night window open.
experience.inviteWithEnding: They found {ending}. Try your own path through the same chapter.
experience.inviteGeneric: Try their chapter and make a different choice.
experience.heroDescription: At the Dream Station, KURU looks after the little worries that arrive after dark. You choose what happens next. Nothing needs to be solved all at once.
experience.chapterTitle: The night has a little room.
experience.chapterDescription: Each chapter is a complete story. Your choices shape the ending, and your progress stays on this device.
experience.howDescription: No endless feed. No open-ended chatbot. Just a small world that remembers what you chose.
experience.step2Desc: Open a chapter directly. No account, download or long setup.
experience.step3Title: Each choice changes the next scene and the ending you receive.
experience.step3Desc: Save your ending on this device or send a friend a link to try their own path.
experience.closingDesc: Nothing here promises to fix a real problem. It is simply a small story, made for a pause.
experience.playFootnote: Your path is saved only on this device.
experience.endingInviteTitle: Leave the window open for a friend.
experience.endingInviteDesc: They can follow your link and make a different choice. Their story stays theirs.
experience.shelfDesc: Your chapters and dream treats are saved in this browser, not in an account.
experience.shelfProgressDesc: Progress is stored locally on this device.
experience.aboutCopy1: The Dream Station is a small interactive-fiction world built around KURU, a sleepy night-shift creature who turns little worries into dream treats.
experience.aboutCopy2: The chapters are pre-written, finite stories. Your choices change the path and ending. There is no open-ended AI companion, free-text prompt or public user feed in this beta.
experience.aboutPrivacy2: Story progress stays in this browser’s local storage.
experience.aboutPrivacy3: No personal story text is sent to an AI model.
experience.aboutPrivacy4: No global vote counts or audience numbers are shown.
experience.aboutPrivacyNote: Private beta for adults 18+. Age is self-declared and not independently verified.
experience.footerTagline: A small story for the quieter hours.
experience.footerCopyright: © 2026 THE DREAM STATION · PROJECT CODE NEXORA
experience.modalDesc: This removes your chapter progress and endings from this browser only. It cannot be undone.
experience.toastCopied: A story link has been copied.
experience.toastShareUnavailable: Sharing is not available in this browser.
experience.toastReset: Your local story shelf has been cleared.
experience.toastSaveFailure: This browser could not save your story. You can still finish this chapter.
experience.toastFinishPrevious: Finish the previous chapter to open this one.
experience.shareTitle: A little note from the Dream Station
